prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: full-width website hero photograph for FrameX Studio, a premium creative post-production studio. This is illustrative concept/demo work.
Primary request: Create a photorealistic cinematic automotive campaign still, ultra-wide landscape 16:9 composition. A sculptural silver-gray vintage-inspired modern sports coupe with no logos, seen from side-rear three-quarter low angle, driving toward the distant horizon through a vast volcanic plain under towering black basalt mountains. The car is in the center-right occupying about one fifth of the width. A faint warm dusty peach cloud trails behind it and catches a sliver of sunlight. Black rocky earth in foreground, elegant winding charcoal asphalt road, jagged mountains softened by atmospheric haze in background. Scene shot at blue hour with a very restrained peach sunset glow near horizon. Deep obsidian and slate blue color grade with warm highlights and pearl silver body. The sky is clear gray blue, detail visible throughout. Composition feels like a real high-budget luxury campaign frame, dramatic, still, quiet, beautiful. No futuristic neon, no exaggerated CGI reflections, no added design elements, no text, no logos, no watermarks. Natural film grain, anamorphic cinema lens, understated motion blur only on road and dust. Leave left third darker and visually calm so white text overlay will be legible; protect landscape's natural composition. Render as a wide cinematic photograph, not a website mockup.
